Example (EN): The business is thriving.
Example (ES): El negocio está prosperando.

Example (EN): Good stewardship of resources is essential.
Example (ES): La buena administración de los recursos es esencial.

Example (EN): Despite the rain, we went outside.
Example (ES): A pesar de la lluvia, salimos afuera.

Example (EN): She is overseeing the entire project.
Example (ES): Ella está supervisando todo el proyecto.

Example (EN): It is incumbent on us to act responsibly.
Example (ES): Es obligatorio que actuemos de manera responsable.
Notes: Can also be a noun meaning the current holder of an office: 'el titular del cargo'.

Example (EN): The lighthouse beacons guide ships safely to shore.
Example (ES): Los faros guían a los barcos de forma segura hacia la costa.
Notes: Figuratively: 'beacons of hope' = faros de esperanza.

Example (EN): A playwright is a wright who crafts plays.
Example (ES): Un dramaturgo es un artesano que crea obras de teatro.
Notes: Archaic/poetic for a skilled maker or builder. Common in compounds: playwright, wheelwright, shipwright.

Example (EN): She peeked through the window to see what was happening.
Example (ES): Ella echó un vistazo por la ventana para ver qué pasaba.
Notes: Also a noun: 'take a peek' = echar un vistazo.

Example (EN): Graduating was a major milestone in her life.
Example (ES): Graduarse fue un hito importante en su vida.
Notes: Literally a stone marking distance on a road; figuratively a significant achievement or stage.

Example (EN): The town square was the main gather point for the community.
Example (ES): La plaza del pueblo era el principal punto de encuentro de la comunidad.
Notes: Also written as one word: 'gatherpoint'. Refers to a designated meeting or assembly location.
Spanish: Punto de encuentro / Punto de reunión

Example (EN): She thoughtfully considered every option before deciding.
Example (ES): Ella consideró reflexivamente cada opción antes de decidir.
Notes: Conveys careful, considerate thinking. Also used to mean 'with kindness/consideration': 'He thoughtfully prepared a meal' = Preparó una comida con mucho cuidado.

Example (EN): The wedding reception was held on the event lawn.
Example (ES): La recepción de la boda se celebró en el prado para eventos.
Spanish: Prado para eventos / Jardín de eventos

Example (EN): Through hard work, she forged a successful career.
Example (ES): Gracias a su esfuerzo, forjó una carrera exitosa.
Notes: Can mean "shape/create" figuratively, or "heat and shape metal" literally. Also used in expressions like forge ahead.

Example (EN): The desk was covered in clutter.
Example (ES): El escritorio estaba lleno de desorden.
Notes: Can be a noun (mess) or a verb (to clutter = llenar de cosas innecesarias). Common in UI/UX: visual clutter

Example (EN): Plants thrive in sunlight
Example (ES): Las plantas prosperan con la luz solar
Notes: Means to grow, develop, or be successful. Adjective form: thriving

Example (EN): She took a quick glance at her phone.
Example (ES): Ella echó un vistazo rápido a su teléfono
Notes: A brief or quick look. Can be a noun (take a glance) or a verb (glance at). Similar to peek, but less secretive

Example (EN): They had a spirited discussion about the project
Example (ES): Tuvieron una animada discusión sobre el proyecto
Notes: Describes someone or something energetic, lively, enthusiastic, or full of spirit

Example (EN): Patience and honesty are valuable traits
Example (ES): La paciencia y la honestidad son rasgos valiosos
Notes: Refers to characteristics, qualities, or distinguishing features of a person, animal, or thing

Example (EN): Procrastinators often delay important tasks until the last minute
Example (ES): Los procrastinadores suelen posponer tareas importantes hasta el último momento
Notes: Refers to people who habitually postpone or delay tasks or decisions. Singular: procrastinator
Spanish: Procrastinadores / Personas que posponen las cosas

Example (EN): It was an unpleasant experience that I would rather forget
Example (ES): Fue una experiencia desagradable que preferiría olvidar.
Notes: Describes something not enjoyable, uncomfortable, disagreeable, or causing discomfort. Opposite of pleasant

Example (EN): The lack of communication caused several problems.
Example (ES): La falta de comunicación causó varios problemas
Notes: Can be a noun (lack of) or a verb (to lack = carecer de).

Example (EN): It was an unpleasant experience that I would rather forget
Example (ES): Fue una experiencia desagradable que preferiría olvidar
Notes: Describes something not enjoyable, uncomfortable, disagreeable, or causing discomfort. Opposite of pleasant

Example (EN): His forgetfulness caused him to miss several appointments.
Example (ES): Su falta de memoria hizo que perdiera varias citas
Notes: The tendency to forget things easily. Related to memory lapses or absent-mindedness

Example (EN): His behavior during the meeting was very professional
Example (ES): Su comportamiento durante la reunión fue muy profesional
Notes: Refers to the way a person, animal, or thing acts or conducts itself. In British English, it is often spelled behaviour.
